scope: Splendor core game, 1st edition (2014), complete authoritative extracted/splendor-rules.txt. No expansions or later-edition additions.
question_design: Added from independent source-review challenge, not from reader answers; original source-backed objects unchanged.

grading_standard.correct: All requested material facts correct, no unresolved part or contradiction.
grading_standard.partial: Missing or explicitly unresolved requested fact, without material contradiction.
grading_standard.coverage: Correct claims need summary support; unsupported guesses cannot establish pass.

answers.question: Before revealing the noble tiles during setup, what must you do with them? May players hand-pick their preferred nobles instead of selecting the revealed tiles from a shuffled set?
answers.expected_answer: Shuffle the noble tiles before revealing the required number. Reveal tiles from that shuffled selection, rather than hand-picking preferred nobles.
material_facts: Shuffle the noble tiles before revealing nobles.
Reveal from the shuffled set; no hand-picking of preferred nobles is part of the setup procedure.
answers.novelty: Independent saturation challenge found that originalQ3 asks only development-deck shuffling. Prior noble setup questions test counts and removed tiles, not shuffling/random selection. Corrects ledgerR07’s overclaim.
